mapper.sql: FROM training_answer a JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=a.owner_id AND q.session_id=a.session_id AND q.id=a.question_id JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.session_id JOIN ai_evaluation_access e ON e.owner_id=a.owner_id AND e.session_id=a.session_id AND e.question_id=a.question_id AND e.answer_id=a.id WHERE a.owner_id=#{owner} AND a.session_id=#{sessionId} AND a.question_id=#{questionId} AND a.id=#{answerId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.owner_id,a.session_id,a.question_id,a.id AS answer_id,s.mode,s.status AS session_status, s.config_json,q.source_question_id,q.source_version_id,q.question_kind,q.snapshot_json, a.content_json,a.version_number AS answer_number,a.answer_condition,a.assistance_event_sequence, a.exposure_json,a.created_at AS answer_created_at,e.early_feedback,e.granted_at
